source: A massive forest spanning a wide area with very tall pine trees — trunks are bare for the first 10-15 studs so players can easily walk underneath, with full foliage canopies high above. The trees should be thick-trunked and widely spaced. Include a large central lake with shallow edges. Scatter rocks, fallen logs, bushes, and grassy clearings throughout. The ground is earthy with patches of grass. This is a survival game forest — it should feel huge, immersive, and natural.
scene_prompt: Create a massive, immersive 3D survival forest spanning a wide area. Thick-trunked, very tall pine trees are widely spaced throughout; their trunks remain bare for the first 10–15 studs to leave clear walking space beneath dense foliage canopies high overhead. Place a large central lake with shallow edges, surrounded by earthy ground with patches of grass, grassy clearings, scattered rocks, fallen logs, and bushes. Maintain forest depth in every direction, with the lake as the main central landmark and tall tree canopy enclosing the scene.
blob:
### Genre
`Survival` is the dominant genre: the author explicitly frames this as a survival-game forest. No secondary genre applies.

### Shape and preset
Use `world-biomes`, matching the Resource Survival preset at the broad-world scale, but treat the rendered space as one continuous temperate pine-forest region around its lake rather than inventing additional named biomes. The preset remains recognisable in its expansive natural-world form, while its resource and base-ground options are omitted because they were not requested.

### Config requirements
Use `water-body` as visible geometry: a large central lake with broad shallow banks. Do not add unrequested resource nodes, player build ground, hostile origins, settlements, interiors, or invisible gameplay markers.

### Layout components
Build a huge continuous forest zone extending deeply in every direction, with the lake centered as the sole major landmark and a ring of more open shoreline clearings around it. Widely space very tall, thick-trunked pine trees across the whole map; each trunk is bare for the first 10–15 studs, preserving clear walkable sightlines and passage below dense, high canopies. Thread informal earthy walking clearings and naturally open ground between tree clusters rather than cutting formal roads. Use earthy soil with irregular grass patches, grassy clearings, scattered rocks, bushes, and fallen logs to break up the ground plane. Keep the lake edges shallow and gradual, with rocks and grass thinning toward the water. There is no constructed boundary; the forest density and uninterrupted canopy visually absorb the outer edge. Compose the lake as the central readable opening, framed by tall trunks and canopy, with forest depth visible beyond every shore.

### Render order
Use `isometric`: the scene has no topology that would make play invalid if inferred from the visual composition, so the immersive forest look should lead.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge, driven by the stated wide-area forest and deep tree cover in every direction. Theme: immersive natural temperate pine wilderness, earthy and quiet. Use `P4` because `world-biomes` is the Survival world-scale shape, and `CHECK` because the central lake is a real water feature; its shallow open surface should remain legible from above.
